deficiencies.description: The rewrite replaces 'adolescence' with 'differentiation', changing a named developmental life stage into a biological process.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: during adolescence and maturation, this occurs from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: differentiation and maturation also occur from infancy to adulthood.
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student would miss that adolescence is specifically cited as a life stage between infancy and adulthood during which maturation occurs.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite conflates two separate roles of the basement membrane ('signaling' and 'basis for their adherence') into one ('signalling basis for their adherence').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: provides a signaling and basis for their adherence to this layer.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: provides a signalling basis for their adherence to this layer.
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student would learn that the basement membrane only provides a signalling basis for adherence, rather than providing both signalling and a physical foundation/basis for adherence.
